title: Self-Build Planning Permission (Scotland)
description: Scottish planning permission workflow for a self-build dwelling. Involves the applicant (member of public), structural engineer, ecologist, Caledonian Water, and the local authority planning department. Features conditional routing for protected species, document uploads, rejection paths, and Planning Permission Verifiable Credential issuance.
author: Sorcha Team

template.title: Self-Build Planning Permission (Scotland)
template.description: A realistic Scottish planning permission process for a self-build house. Six organisations and seven participants collaborate across six actions with conditional routing for protected species, document uploads as evidence, and a Planning Permission Verifiable Credential issued on approval.

metadata.features: Multi-Org, Conditional Routing, Calculations, Rejection, Verifiable Credential, Document Upload

participants.name: Self-Builder
participants.description: Applicant seeking planning permission for a self-build dwelling. Submits application with site plans, design statement, and supporting evidence.

participants.name: Lead Engineer
participants.description: Conducts site investigation, produces ground conditions report, and recommends foundation type.

participants.name: Senior Ecologist
participants.description: Conducts Phase 1 habitat survey, assesses protected species, and produces mitigation plan if required.

participants.name: Connections Officer
participants.description: Assesses water supply feasibility and drainage capacity for the proposed development.

participants.name: Planning Officer
participants.description: Reviews planning application against local development plan, consults statutory bodies, and issues planning permission decision.

actions.title: Submit Planning Application
actions.description: Self-builder submits planning application with site plans, design statement, and building specifications. This is the entry point for the planning process.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: This is the application to Strathcarron Council for planning permission for a self-build dwelling. Three short pages: the project and site, the dwelling you want to build, and the supporting drawings.

x-pages.title: Project & site
x-pages.description: Where you're building and what the land is currently used for.

x-pages.title: Dwelling
x-pages.description: The house you want to build.

x-pages.title: Supporting documents
x-pages.description: Drawings and design statement required by the council.

routes.description: Route to structural engineer for site investigation

elements.title: Site is within a Conservation Area

actions.title: Site Investigation Report
actions.description: Structural engineer conducts site investigation, analyses ground conditions, and produces a report with foundation recommendations. Calculates a foundation risk score that informs downstream decisions.

actions.title: Ecological Survey
actions.description: Ecologist conducts Phase 1 habitat survey, checks for protected species (bats, red squirrels, badgers, raptors), and assesses ecological impact. If protected species are found, routes to mitigation plan (Action 3b).

routes.description: Protected species found — mitigation plan required before proceeding
No protected species — proceed to utilities consultation

elements.title: Protected species found on or near site

actions.title: Species Mitigation Plan
actions.description: Conditional action — only reached if protected species were found in the ecological survey. Ecologist produces a Species Protection Plan with mitigation measures and any NatureScot licensing requirements.

routes.description: Mitigation plan complete — proceed to utilities consultation

elements.title: Construction Timing Restrictions (e.g. no works March-August)

actions.title: Utilities Consultation
actions.description: Caledonian Water assesses water supply feasibility and drainage capacity for the proposed development. Can reject the application if connection is not feasible.

routes.description: Water/drainage feasible — proceed to planning review

actions.title: Planning Review & Decision
actions.description: Planning officer reviews all consultation responses, assesses compliance with the Strathcarron Local Development Plan, and makes a decision. Can approve, request amendments, or refuse. Calculates the planning application fee.

dataSchemas.x-introduction: Review the accumulated consultation responses and record the planning decision. Kept on one page so you can see policy, consultation and decision together.

x-sections.title: Policy compliance
x-sections.description: Local Development Plan check and design/landscape assessment.

x-sections.title: Decision
x-sections.description: Approval, conditions, refusal reasons and officer report.

elements.title: Complies with Strathcarron Local Development Plan
Access and parking arrangements are adequate

actions.title: Issue Planning Permission
actions.description: Planning officer formally issues planning permission. A Planning Permission Verifiable Credential is minted and issued to the self-builder, which becomes a prerequisite for the Building Warrant application on the Building Standards Register.
